profile     @claude
            Claude Code: binary and skills read-only, credentials and settings generated.
defined in  builtin:base.toml

  includes         @sys
                   @home
  ro               {home}/.local/bin/claude:/run/snug/bin/claude
                   {home}/.local/share/claude
                   {home}/.claude/skills
                   {home}/.claude/plugins
  environ.inherit  ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
                   EDITOR
                   NO_COLOR
                   PAGER
                   VISUAL
  optional         {home}/.local/bin/claude {home}/.local/share/claude {home}/.claude/skills {home}/.claude/plugins

To see what this actually produces for a directory:
  snug --dry-run -p @claude <dir>
